description: 8-TC thermocouple input ioThinx 45MR slot module. Addresses are module-relative; actual PDU address = slot_base + relative_address. FC01: tcResetMinValue ch0-7 (W=1 to reset), tcResetMaxValue ch0-7 (W=1 to reset). FC03: tcResetMinValueAll (rel 0), tcResetMaxValueAll (rel 1). FC04: tcValueScaled ch0-7 (f32 2-regs/ch = 16 regs), tcValueScaledMin (16 regs), tcValueScaledMax (16 regs), tcType ch0-7 (0=J 1=K 2=T 3=E 4=R 5=S 6=B 7=N 14=±78.126mV 15=±39.062mV 16=±19.532mV), tcStatus ch0-7 (0=normal 1=burnout).
